title: STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Rejoin the Fight: Welcome Home Bundle

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38349861/078a2eced0d0a338b017d3dc7bee658496b3b79e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Rejoin the Fight and return to a galaxy far, far away with the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147370/STAR_WARS_The_Old_Republic__Rejoin_the_Fight_Welcome_Home/"]Welcome Home Bundle[/url]. Get 90 days of subscription time, 2,400 Cartel Coins, 2 server transfers, and a Commander’s Character Token. Transfer your characters to your friends' server, and jump straight into the action![/p][p]This bundle includes:[/p][list][*][p]90 days of fixed subscription time granting 550 Cartel Coins per month[/p][/*][*][p]2,400 Cartel Coins instantly for the account[/p][/*][*][p]2 Server Transfers[/p][/*][*][p]1 Commander’s Character Token[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The Rejoin the Fight bundle will be available until January 12th, 2027 at 11:00am CT / 5:00pm UTC.[/p][p]This bundle is a one-time purchase and is non-tradable and non-transferable. Bundles are delivered via in-game mail and are available on all characters. After purchase, you may need to fully close the game and restart it before receiving your items.[/p][p]
